scope: retained native analysis-only main self samples; sampled correlation, not exact or removable instruction budget

accepted.ancestry_invariant: Presence in a DWARF inline chain, deduplicated within each PC; groups can overlap and must not be added. Union counts each PC once.

repair.ancestry_invariant: Presence in a DWARF inline chain, deduplicated within each PC; groups can overlap and must not be added. Union counts each PC once.

decision: Reject copying-event frequency alone as the next optimization budget. The largest main source-arm correlations span Return, AssignCv/BindCvRef, ReleaseTemps, FetchObjR and FetchDimR. Quantify full operand/result publication and retirement protocols, using this native decomposition and existing ownership semantics; no new transfer guard or isolated helper layout variant is admitted by source correlation alone.
